performance.verdict: Meta producing leads, but 5 overdue milestones mean spend is flying blind.

findings.text: Pre-Launch Stack Test, LSA Verification, Site/Landing Pages, Ads Launch, and Meta Retargeting Launch — all 5 milestones overdue since 2026-07-31/08-01 per SOW.
CPL improved sharply: 7d CPL down 70.51%, 28-day blended CPL at $74.37 across 7 leads — driven entirely by Meta instant-form format at $282.25 spend.
3-day lead signal (Sep 6–8: 1,1,2) vs prior 3 days (Sep 3–5: 0,1,1) is modestly positive, but total volume remains thin — 7 leads across 28 days.
GBP actions dropped 100% week-over-week; last recorded GBP action was 2026-08-27. Profile appears dark for 12+ consecutive days.
GHL shows 44 opportunities created but 0 appointments and 0 won; 115 contacts vs 7 reported leads suggests intake pipeline is not routing or converting arrivals.

suggestions.text: Escalate all 5 overdue SOW milestones to Nacer immediately; no Google spend or LSA is live 40+ days past deadline.
suggestions.monday_update: Five SOW milestones — Pre-Launch Stack Test, LSA Verification, Site/Landing Pages, Ads Launch, and Meta Retargeting Launch — were all due 2026-07-31 or 2026-08-01 and show no completion event as of 2026-09-09. Google Ads spend is $0 across the entire 28-day window, confirming launch has not occurred. Nacer must provide a cleared status or revised go-live date for each item by 2026-09-12. Success is confirmed when all 5 milestone completion events are logged and Google spend is non-zero.

suggestions.text: Investigate GHL intake leak: 44 opportunities created, 0 appointments booked — confirm routing rules and booking calendar are wired correctly.
suggestions.monday_update: GHL shows 44 opportunities created and 115 contacts but zero appointments scheduled as of the 28-day window ending 2026-09-09. This means leads arriving from Meta's instant form ($282.25 spend, 7 leads) are not converting into booked consults inside the CRM. The SOW requires first contact under 5 minutes and calendar/booking provisioned in Month 1 — confirm booking links, routing rules, and calendar integration are live. Success is at least 1 confirmed appointment booked and visible in GHL by 2026-09-16.

suggestions.text: Watch Meta CPL over next 3 days; if CPL holds below $80 and daily leads stay ≥1, evaluate a modest budget increase then.
suggestions.monday_update: Meta's 'Leads - Instant Form - Awareness' campaign drove CPL down 70.51% this week with a 28-day blended CPL of $74.37 across 7 leads. Volume is still thin and the 3-day lead signal (1, 1, 2) needs one more window to confirm durability. Re-check on 2026-09-12: if CPL remains below $80 and daily lead rate holds at ≥1, bring a scale recommendation of up to +20% daily budget to Sohib for approval.
